IncidentBot: ALERT: Elevated 5xx + gateway timeouts detected for prefix-cache service in eu-west-1. Error rate spike started at 2026-03-15T14:18:41Z (5957654321). Paging oncall.
Elena K.: oncall here — seeing a big jump in 502/504s and also some 500s from upstream. Dashboards show prefix-cache missrate jumped 8x. Tagging SREs. @Maya R. can you grab logs from the cache-proxy fleet?
Maya R.: grabbing logs now. quick look: lots of "KV hydration timeout" and "prefetch queue backlog" in proxy logs. Also seeing repeated vbucket reassignments in kv-coordinator.
Lucas T.: adding that KV shard heartbeats are delayed ~30s for some hosts, causing eviction sweeps to run repeatedly. suspect eviction cycles are thrashing underlying storage IO.
Patrick S.: customer impact: frontend traces show increased latency for /v1/generate, errors affecting ~12% of requests in eu-west-1. A handful of paying customers report timeouts. Raising severity to Sev2.
Elena K.: immediate mitigation plan: 1) disable background prefetch on prefix-cache (config toggle) 2) enable cache-bypass header for critical routes 3) scale up cache-proxy pool by +3 nodes and set circuit-breaker to failfast for kv reads.
Maya R.: commands I ran: ```kubectl -n prod set env deploy/prefix-cache PREFETCH_ENABLED=false --record && kubectl rollout restart deploy/prefix-cache``` logs show rollout starting. Also applied feature flag: enable_cache_bypass_for_critical=true via ff-service.
Lucas T.: spun up 3 extra proxy instances in eu-west-1: prefix-cache-proxy-7..9. Noticed a backlog drain after restart — missrate down ~40% already. Will keep an eye on IO.
Nima P.: temporary routing change in place: traffic for high-SLA customers routed to eu-central-1 fallback pool via smart-router. Added rate-limit to region to reduce load oscillation. Applied at 14:22Z.
Maya R.: Ongoing: still seeing occasional KV index corruption markers in logs (checksums mismatch) for 2 shards. I'm running a read-only index sanity check script now: ```/opt/tools/kv-sanity --shard 42,77 --mode=check``` will report back.
Elena K.: good. if checksums confirm corruption, we'll need to mark shards readonly and hand off to storage team for repair. until then keep bypass + no-prefetch.
Patrick S.: Notifying affected customers and CS to open tickets. Draft message: "We're experiencing elevated timeouts in eu-west-1 due to cache hydration issues; mitigation in progress and some requests may fail or be slower. ETA updates in 30m." Sending now. :email:
IncidentBot: Incident created: INC-20260315-87 (Sev2). PagerDuty escalated to oncall-sre and storage oncall.
Maya R.: sanity check results: shard 42 shows checksum drift; shard 77 clean. logs attached to INC-20260315-87. I recommend quarantining shard 42 (read-only) to stop further writes: ```curl -XPOST https://kv-admin/quarantine -d '{"shard":42}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer ****'``` (ran and returned 202)
Lucas T.: quarantined. eviction sweeps stopped cycling for now. missstorm amplitude reduced. gateway 502s down to ~3% and latency p95 back to baseline for many routes.
Elena K.: next steps before handoff: 1) leave PREFETCH_ENABLED=false 2) keep cache-bypass for critical routes for 1 hour 3) storage team to run index repair on shard 42 4) follow-up postmortem owner assigned.
Nima P.: I'll take the handoff in 45m. summary for next oncall: incident id INC-20260315-87, root cause suspected: hydration cascade from overlapping eviction + background prefetch causing IO thrash and checksum drift on shard 42 leading to 5xx. Mitigations applied: prefetch disabled, cache-bypass, scale-up proxies, shard quarantined, traffic rerouted for high-SLA flows. Current status: degraded but improving (5xx ~2.8%).
Patrick S.: CS updated; we've flagged 6 customers, one enterprise account got timeouts >30s earlier — offering credits if needed. Will coordinate post-incident comms.
Maya R.: telemetry note: please keep an eye on disk iops for kv hosts and kv-coordinator heartbeat jitter. I pushed a Grafana panel for quick view: https://grafana.redwood/in/caches/hydration-cascade
Elena K.: thanks team. tagging storage-oncall: @storage-team (please prioritize inode/index repair for shard 42). I'll handoff to @Nima P. in 30m with the runbook appended to the incident ticket.
Nima P.: ack. I'll maintain watch and prepare rollback steps if the read-only quarantine causes upstream issues. Leaving channel open for any regressions. :eyes:
IncidentBot: Status update scheduled at +30m."
